companyName: Plug Power Fuel Cell Asset SPVs
summary: The generic row conflates historical Generate sale-leaseback equipment owners with a later corporate loan. Generate Capital and the named SLB 1/II lessors held equipment title beginning in 2016-2017, but the 2019-2022 Generate Lending/Generate PPL SPV I exposure was secured debt only and was fully repaid in December 2022. No later equity conversion, foreclosure or current Generate ownership was found, so the generic active row should be excluded and retired.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The direct member/fund ownership of Generate Plug Power SLB 1, LLC and Generate Plug Power SLB II, LLC is not publicly disclosed.
